prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A solitary man stands centered against a vast, pitch-black background, creating a striking sense of isolation and emptiness. He is dressed in a dark suit with a light-colored dress shirt, the formal attire contrasting with the stark minimalism of the scene. His hair is shoulder-length and straight, framing a neutral, almost expressionless face that gazes directly forward, evoking a sense of introspection or existential contemplation. The lighting is soft and focused, illuminating only the man and leaving the surrounding space in deep shadow, heightening the dramatic effect and drawing all attention to the lone figure. The composition is symmetrical and minimalist, with the subject positioned at the center of the frame and ample negative space enveloping him. The color palette is subdued, dominated by blacks and muted tones, reinforcing the somber, contemplative mood. The overall style is cinematic and surreal, reminiscent of avant-garde or experimental film, with a sense of stillness and psychological depth. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, and the depth of field is shallow, ensuring the man is in sharp focus while the background remains an infinite void.
